items.name: UKMTO: tanker struck by unknown projectile 19 nm NE of Lima, Oman, 1338 GMT Tuesday; crew safe
items.headline: UKMTO: tanker struck by unknown projectile 19 nm NE of Lima, Oman, 1338 GMT Tuesday; crew safe
items.source: Anadolu Agency, 10 Nov 2026 / CBS live 12:48 EST
items.claim: UKMTO reported that at 1338 GMT on Tuesday 10 Nov a tanker was struck by an unknown projectile about 19 nautical miles northeast of Lima, Oman (Gulf of Oman side of the strait); the crew was reported safe, no environmental damage, and the captain would 'conduct damage assessment at first light'. Vessel name, flag and UKMTO advisory number not printed. Al Jazeera (11 Nov) says UKMTO reported incidents involving two tankers on Tuesday, one struck northeast of Lima. This is the first UKMTO-confirmed strike in gate; it is NOT confirmation of the IRGC 'two tankers burning' mine claim (position and mechanism differ).

items.name: Liberia-flagged VLCC Fujairah Energy hit by projectile in the Arabian Gulf (Ruwais-Dubai), four crew injured; India confirms 11 Nov
items.headline: Liberia-flagged VLCC Fujairah Energy hit by projectile in the Arabian Gulf (Ruwais-Dubai), four crew injured; India confirms 11 Nov
items.source: Gulf News UAE brief 11 Nov / House of Saud 11 Nov 07:45 UTC (citing India's shipping minister Sonowal)
items.claim: India's Ports, Shipping and Waterways Minister Sarbananda Sonowal said on 11 Nov that the Liberia-flagged VLCC MT Fujairah Energy (22 crew, 6 Indian), sailing Al Ruwais to Dubai inside the Gulf between Abu Dhabi and Dubai, was struck by a projectile on 10 Nov; four crew were injured, one Indian with minor injuries taken ashore, the other 18 'safe and accounted for', no fatalities. UKMTO confirmed an incident with damage, crew status and environmental impact 'unknown'; no advisory number or follow-up as of 11 Nov; operator not identified (straits.live's 11 Nov teaser calls it a 'Sinokor VLCC' with four injured, per TradeWinds - not read). Injuries only, no deaths: not a casualties-grade hard event. Whether this is the same hull as the Lima strike or the ADNOC vessel is unresolved.

items.name: ADNOC L&S confirms one of its vessels damaged in an attack in UAE territorial waters; tanker VIEIRA leaking off Fujairah
items.headline: ADNOC L&S confirms one of its vessels damaged in an attack in UAE territorial waters; tanker VIEIRA leaking off Fujairah
items.source: Gulf News live blog 10 Nov 18:47 GST / Gulf News UAE brief 11 Nov
items.claim: ADNOC Logistics & Services said on Tuesday 10 Nov (Gulf News 18:47 GST) that one of its vessels 'sustained damage following an attack' in UAE territorial waters in the Arabian Gulf, 'response efforts by the relevant teams are ongoing', without naming the vessel or the extent of damage, and urged reliance on official sources. straits.live 11-10 logs the same via The National as single-source. Separately Gulf News 11 Nov: the tanker VIEIRA was reportedly leaking about 65 km off Fujairah and Khor Fakkan closed Al Luluia beach after oil patches (the beach closure was logged 9 Nov by CBS). First confirmed attack inside UAE waters since the August incidents per Gulf News.

items.name: Update vs 11-10 file: IRGC adds a 'third' mine-struck tanker Tuesday, Iran's Navy 'another' early Wednesday; UKMTO logs an unspecified tanker incident 11 Nov; two-tanker claim still unconfirmed
items.headline: Update vs 11-10 file: IRGC adds a 'third' mine-struck tanker Tuesday, Iran's Navy 'another' early Wednesday; UKMTO logs an unspecified tanker incident 11 Nov; two-tanker claim still unconfirmed
items.source: Tasnim 11 Nov 13:57 Tehran / Bernama 11 Nov (UKMTO) / Arab News 11 Nov
items.claim: Tasnim 11 Nov: the IRGC Navy said Tuesday afternoon a 'third' tanker exploded after striking a mine on an unauthorised route in the eastern strait, and Iran's Navy said early Wednesday 'another offending tanker caught fire after hitting a naval mine in the prohibited area east of the strategic waterway'; both unnamed; the IRGC blamed the routing on destroyed coastal radar and navigation aids 'south of the strait' and said safe passage 'requires coordination with Iran's Armed Forces'. UKMTO said Wednesday it 'had received a report of an incident involving a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz' from military authorities with crew, damage and environmental impact unknown and no mention of a mine (Bernama/Arab News). straits.live 11-10: the two-tanker claim was carried by 13 outlets and 'no maritime authority has confirmed it'. House of Saud dates the IRGC 'three tankers starting early Sunday' claim to 8 Nov, so the IRGC count may be cumulative rather than three new hulls on 10 Nov.

items.name: Rezaei to Al Mayadeen: talks or a Qatar meeting 'a pure lie', US reply 'insufficient and deceptive', Hormuz stays shut until seven conditions met; Araghchi: 'only solution' is diplomacy on Iran's terms
items.headline: Rezaei to Al Mayadeen: talks or a Qatar meeting 'a pure lie', US reply 'insufficient and deceptive', Hormuz stays shut until seven conditions met; Araghchi: 'only solution' is diplomacy on Iran's terms
items.source: Al Jazeera 11 Nov / Gulf News live 10 Nov 21:00 GST / Haaretz 10 Nov
items.claim: SNSC secretary Mohsen Rezaei told Al Mayadeen on 10 Nov that claims 'about continuing negotiations or holding a meeting in Qatar is a pure lie', that Washington talks up talks to lower oil prices, that the US 'initial response was insufficient and deceptive, and we are still waiting for an explicit and clear response', and that Hormuz stays closed until the seven conditions (incl. lifting sanctions and the naval blockade, ending fighting on all fronts incl. Lebanon) are met. Earlier Tuesday (CBS 08:42 EST) he said the US had been 'wrecked' and should 'SURRENDER' to the seven conditions. Araghchi to IRNA Tuesday: 'The only solution is to adopt a language of respect, engage in diplomacy, and address Iran's demands and conditions'; Gulf News 16:36 GST: 'The conflict with Iran will not be resolved through military means'; he also said Hormuz could reopen within two days if demands are met and (Iran Intl) that there are no plans for Rezaei to meet Vance.

items.name: Rezaei: 'not a single particle' of enriched material leaves Iran; nuclear proposal sent via Qatar to be discussed only after seven demands met; Araghchi asks UN/IAEA to condemn US $20m reward
items.headline: Rezaei: 'not a single particle' of enriched material leaves Iran; nuclear proposal sent via Qatar to be discussed only after seven demands met; Araghchi asks UN/IAEA to condemn US $20m reward
items.source: Asharq Al-Awsat (Reuters) 11 Nov 10:56 GMT
items.claim: Rezaei said 11 Nov that 'Iran will not allow even a single particle of enriched nuclear material to leave the country' and that there are no negotiations taking place with Washington; a senior Iranian official told Reuters Iran had sent a nuclear proposal via Qatar to be discussed only after the US meets its seven demands, while Washington says nuclear issues must be part of any initial talks. Araghchi wrote to the UN Secretary-General, Security Council and IAEA DG asking them to condemn the US $20m reward for nuclear-programme tips. Iran continues to block IAEA inspectors from Fordow, Natanz and Isfahan (IAEA pre-strike estimate 440.9 kg of 60% HEU). No IAEA/Grossi statement dated 10-11 Nov found.

items.name: Rubio at G7 Paris: 'no need for major combat operations' while the 'devastating' economic campaign works; Qatari PM makes unscheduled G7 stop; no joint G7 Iran statement; 11 Nov: no 'pallets of cash'
items.headline: Rubio at G7 Paris: 'no need for major combat operations' while the 'devastating' economic campaign works; Qatari PM makes unscheduled G7 stop; no joint G7 Iran statement; 11 Nov: no 'pallets of cash'
items.source: Reuters via Internazionale 10 Nov / Iran International 10 Nov / Al Jazeera 11 Nov / Gulf News live 11 Nov 03:37 GST
items.claim: At the G7 foreign ministers' Middle East session in Paris on Tuesday 10 Nov, Rubio told ministers (per four G7 diplomats) that Washington will keep imposing 'devastating' economic costs on Iran, has options beyond resuming war or accepting Iran's demands, and (two diplomats) called Iranian authorities 'lunatics'; publicly he said the US is 'open to diplomacy' and 'the economic campaign is so devastating that right now there is no need for major combat operations', with the military ready if 'red lines' are crossed (CBS 10:58 EST). Qatar's PM Sheikh Mohammed made an unscheduled stop in Paris (Gulf News 14:09 GST), met the Saudi FM and European ministers and was 'cautiously optimistic' a diplomatic solution remains possible; French FM Barrot said renewed strikes have 'not been completely ruled out' (18:36 GST). No joint G7 statement or follow-up venue/date reported. Early 11 Nov (03:37 GST) Rubio rejected Iran's reparations demand: 'pallets of cash, which the president has made clear is not going to happen'.

items.name: Kalin: Qatar to host Vance-Rezaei talks 'next week' (Tasnim denies); JPost: Trump gave Vance 'a few days'; Reuters diplomats describe Vance-vs-Rubio/Miller/Bessent split
items.headline: Kalin: Qatar to host Vance-Rezaei talks 'next week' (Tasnim denies); JPost: Trump gave Vance 'a few days'; Reuters diplomats describe Vance-vs-Rubio/Miller/Bessent split
items.source: Iran International 10 Nov 00:56 UTC / Reuters via Internazionale 10 Nov
items.claim: Turkey's intelligence chief Ibrahim Kalin said Qatar would host Vance and SNSC secretary Rezaei 'next week' (Clash Report/Axar, not read; relayed by Iran International); Tasnim's denial is already recorded. Two diplomatic sources told the Jerusalem Post that Trump gave Vance and other officials 'a few days' to reach an agreement; Vance speaks with the Qatari PM 'almost daily'. Reuters (10 Nov): one G7 diplomat said Rubio, new White House chief of staff Stephen Miller and Treasury Secretary Bessent back maintaining heavy economic pressure, Vance prefers a deal and blamed the midterm losses on the war, and Trump reportedly believes a workable deal is not currently possible. No Witkoff item in gate.

items.name: Hegseth: 'The ironclad blockade unbroken. We control the Strait of Hormuz'; 'historic MILITARY VICTORY'; House refers impeachment to committee 211-204 on 11 Nov
items.headline: Hegseth: 'The ironclad blockade unbroken. We control the Strait of Hormuz'; 'historic MILITARY VICTORY'; House refers impeachment to committee 211-204 on 11 Nov
items.source: Iran International 11 Nov 02:11 GMT (Pentagon briefing 10 Nov) / CBS live 10 Nov 09:28 EST / Gulf News live 11 Nov 04:55 GST
items.claim: At a Pentagon briefing on 10 Nov Hegseth said 'The ironclad blockade unbroken. We control the Strait of Hormuz', that the blockade of Iranian ports remains in place, and called the war a 'historic MILITARY VICTORY' (CBS 09:28 EST). Early 11 Nov the House voted 211-204 to refer Rep. Massie's impeachment resolution against Hegseth to the Judiciary Committee, effectively ending the effort for the 119th Congress (Gulf News 04:55 GST). CBS 13:18 EST 10 Nov: Iranian and Russian officials discussed countering Task Force Iron Gate, which targets overland and Caspian trade.

items.name: GCC approves a military command headquarters in Kuwait; Egypt 'strengthening' its military presence in Saudi Arabia
items.headline: GCC approves a military command headquarters in Kuwait; Egypt 'strengthening' its military presence in Saudi Arabia
items.source: Gulf News live 10 Nov 14:12 and 18:37 GST
items.claim: GCC Secretary-General Jasem Al Budaiwi said on 10 Nov that GCC states 'have approved the establishment of a military command headquarters in Kuwait' (Gulf News 14:12 GST). Egypt's foreign minister said Egypt already has a military presence in Saudi Arabia and 'We are strengthening that' (18:37 GST). No details on timing or forces.

items.name: Update vs 11-10 file: Houthis deny East-West pipeline strike, claim Riyadh pumping stations, airport and financial hub; coalition downs ballistic missile Tuesday evening; Marib missiles 11 Nov
items.headline: Update vs 11-10 file: Houthis deny East-West pipeline strike, claim Riyadh pumping stations, airport and financial hub; coalition downs ballistic missile Tuesday evening; Marib missiles 11 Nov
items.source: CBS live 10 Nov 10:29 EST / Gulf News live 10 Nov 19:35 GST, 11 Nov 06:20 GST
items.claim: On 10 Nov the Houthis denied targeting the East-West pipeline in Medina (the 9 Nov 'limited fire' recorded in the 11-10 file) and said they hit pumping stations near Riyadh instead (CBS 10:29 EST); Tuesday evening they claimed attacks on Saudi Arabia including Riyadh's airport and financial hub and the Saudi-led coalition said it 'shot down a ballistic missile' (Gulf News 19:35 GST). Yemen's government said the Houthis fired several ballistic missiles at Marib early 11 Nov (06:20 GST). IndiGo extended suspensions to Jeddah, Madinah, Riyadh and Dammam into late November (21:02 GST). No Saudi claim of responsibility for the pipeline fire.

items.name: IRGC unveils new underground 'missile city' holding ballistic and cruise missiles; DOJ charges three over RAF Fairford plot
items.headline: IRGC unveils new underground 'missile city' holding ballistic and cruise missiles; DOJ charges three over RAF Fairford plot
items.source: Gulf News live 11 Nov 05:22 GST (Tasnim) / CBS live 10 Nov 15:57 EST
items.claim: Tasnim/Gulf News 11 Nov 05:22 GST: the IRGC unveiled a new underground 'missile city' it says holds 'various ballistic and cruise missiles'. CBS 10 Nov 15:57 EST: the US Justice Department charged three men linked to a September attempted attack on RAF Fairford, a base used against Iran; the FBI director alleged nearly 20 attempted attacks. France's EU partners said they were prepared to respond jointly to Paris's attribution of the October 'refrigerator' hacks to an IRGC cyber unit (CBS 07:27 EST), which Iran called 'baseless' (Gulf News 17:12 GST).

items.name: Update vs 11-10 file: South Korean cabinet approves extending Cheonghae Unit to waters south of Oman with EOD team and unmanned minesweeping equipment; needs presidential sign-off and National Assembly
items.headline: Update vs 11-10 file: South Korean cabinet approves extending Cheonghae Unit to waters south of Oman with EOD team and unmanned minesweeping equipment; needs presidential sign-off and National Assembly
items.source: Korea JoongAng Daily, 10 Nov 2026
items.claim: South Korea's cabinet, chaired by President Lee Jae Myung at the Blue House on Tuesday 10 Nov, approved extending the Cheonghae Unit's operating area to waters south of Oman (~650 km from Hormuz) with a maritime patrol aircraft, an EOD team and unmanned minesweeping equipment, explicitly to prepare for 'an international mine-clearing operation in the Strait of Hormuz, which could begin after the US-Iran war ends'; the motion goes to the National Assembly once Lee signs; Defence Minister Kang Shin-chul told the Defence Committee Monday Korea 'would not be involved in or interfere with the war'. No deployment dates. Iran's 9 Nov objection is already recorded. No Japan or China navy item in gate; no actual mine-clearance operation reported (Au79 lists CENTCOM's 8 Nov 'primary lanes cleared' as 'officially denied' by Iran).

items.name: China's Middle East envoy Zhai Jun in Tehran meets SNSC deputy Bagheri Kani; conflict 'cannot be resolved by force'
items.headline: China's Middle East envoy Zhai Jun in Tehran meets SNSC deputy Bagheri Kani; conflict 'cannot be resolved by force'
items.source: The New Arab live blog, 9 Nov 2026 (updated 15:23 UTC)
items.claim: Per an Iranian foreign ministry readout, China's special envoy for the Middle East Zhai Jun met Ali Bagheri Kani, deputy secretary of the SNSC, in Tehran on Monday 9 Nov, said China is willing to promote new progress in bilateral relations and that the prolonged, spreading regional conflict cannot be resolved by force; Zhai is visiting Iran, Oman and Saudi Arabia this month. Not in the 11-09 or 11-10 files (which found no China item), hence late: true. Still no Wang Yi statement; Trump's APEC Xi/Putin remark is already recorded.

items.name: Update vs 11-10 file: UAE airspace open; EASA advisories for Iran/UAE/Bahrain/Kuwait/Qatar/Oman valid to 16 Nov; Etihad Riyadh/Dammam suspended to 19 Nov; flydubai Dammam still cancelled
items.headline: Update vs 11-10 file: UAE airspace open; EASA advisories for Iran/UAE/Bahrain/Kuwait/Qatar/Oman valid to 16 Nov; Etihad Riyadh/Dammam suspended to 19 Nov; flydubai Dammam still cancelled
items.source: Gulf News UAE brief, 11 Nov 2026 10:50 GST
items.claim: Gulf News 11 Nov (Day 256): UAE airspace remains open with carriers running individual risk assessments; EASA conflict-zone advisories cover Iran, the UAE, Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar and Oman 'valid until November 16 unless revised'; Etihad's Abu Dhabi-Riyadh and -Dammam flights suspended until 19 Nov; flydubai's Dammam service still listed 'canceled' (the 11-10 file had it resuming 10 Nov); Emirates and Air Arabia report selected Saudi disruptions; Iranian-operated flights to the UAE remain suspended; UAE MoFA travel ban to Iran active. Main passenger impact is on Saudi routes tied to Houthi attacks.
